title: Lowcountry Premier Fly Fishing
specs: Sight fishing for redfish in Charleston lowcountry
Use of 2019 Maverick HPX-S skiff designed for shallow water
Opportunities to fish for redfish, speckled sea trout, sharks, sheepshead, black drum, tarpon, false albacore, bluefish
Fishing best from late March to end of November, with winter trips available
polarized sunglasses and a hat recommended
lightweight/quick-dry clothing in summer months recommended
wading booties if you have them recommended
includes: rods, reels, line, leader & tippet, flies
blurb: Guests fish for redfish and other species in the Charleston lowcountry using fly fishing techniques. Trips include poling along grass banks, oyster beds, creeks, and open shallow water, with sight casting and sometimes stalking tailing fish on foot during flood tides. The operator uses skiffs designed for shallow water and offers professional guidance and equipment.
